name: token-conformance
fits: a spacing audit built on the fm-spacing-rhythm-audit collect, apply and verify helpers: its code regions extend those helpers, and its prose is about auto-layout padding, gaps and spacing tokens
templateLines: - Tokens off the 4/8 rhythm: <token> = <value> (<n> values); a scale decision, not a defect

lineRewrites.from: let MODE = "discover"; // discover | tokens | rhythm // without the token-conformance pack this reads: let MODE = "rhythm"

proseSentences: Token mode adds these lines: Mode (printed in both modes whenever the file has spacing tokens), Bound values (in place of Bound to variables, which rhythm mode keeps), Tokens off the 4/8 rhythm (omitted when none), Bind opportunities, On rhythm, no matching token, Matches an alias (omitted when 0), and Matched but not offered (from `matchedCollections`, omitted when empty); the Bind opportunities table, when there are any, before the main table; and the Fix column's bind form, "bind Space/200", beside "set 8" for a value with no token within 4.
descriptionSentences: With spacing tokens in the file it audits against those tokens and binds values to the matching variable.
cost: one extra collect call (discover) when the file has tokens; a page audit cost 22 to 24 credits either way on 2026-11-02, and 36 on 2026-11-13
